rationale: Dune field in Lyot Crater (USGS item description); the same dunes as HiRISE ESP_074942_2295, Frosted Dunes in the Depths of Winter
credit: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona; DTM distributed by USGS
projection: local stereographic on the Mars sphere: +proj=stere +lat_0=49.1773 +lon_0=29.0378 +k=1 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +R=3396190.0 +units=m +no_defs
height_reference: Mars aeroid; heightfield is relative to height_min_m
r16: uint16 little-endian, row 0 north, 0 = height_min_m, 65535 = height_max_m

slope_1m.note: Dominated by stereo noise; resolving power is coarser than the spacing

measured_vs_generated: Shape at about 1 m is measured; anything finer is generated
